title: Pulse: Show keeps Mine and Resolved, + New lists what you can start, a × on every pop-up; table menus never cut off; drawer links land on their card
why: Jason, 2026-11-19, in one pop-up: "Drop four, keep Mine+Resolved" (Operational Queues, Alerts, Order Mgmt and System Health went; the funnels and Group cover them, the bell keeps critical, overdue and escalated); + New "should offer the different kinds of messages or posts someone can make" (Post to the team, A task, A client order, A listing; An email and A message to one teammate shown as coming, with what to do today); "anything that pops open should have a way to close it" (a × on Quick actions, + New, the filter list and Group, with Esc and a click outside). And a fix to approved work, from his screenshot: the ⋯ menu on a table's last rows was cut off by the table's rounded corners; now the corner cells carry the rounding and a menu near the window's bottom opens upward. And Jason's "i thought we fixed this. Open card shows the specific place to fix issues.": the admin's drawer put its panel=1 after a link's #card, so the page never landed on the card; the #card now stays last. app/ui/pulse-ui.php, app/admin/kit-css.php, js/admin-kit.js, FAQ.
